Custom Apparel for Penrose's Rural Fremont County Community

Penrose is a small rural community about 12 miles east of Cañon City in Fremont County — locally known as the Model Rocket Capital of the World, home to Estes Industries, the global leader in model rocketry. It's a working-class agricultural and manufacturing community where custom workwear, school apparel, and small-event gear are practical, valued needs. ARK offers DTF printing with no minimum for small-batch community orders, alongside full screen printing runs for larger groups.

Penrose is served by the Fremont RE-2 School District alongside Florence, with Penrose Elementary feeding into Florence Junior/Senior High School. The Estes Industries connection gives Penrose a unique identity within the region's small rural communities. Community events, agricultural fairs, and the local businesses that employ Penrose residents all generate occasional custom apparel needs. We ship from Colorado Springs, about 55 miles northeast, with reliable turnaround.
